info.name: AudioSeal Watermark — Embed & Verify
info.description:
Embed an AudioSeal watermark into uploaded audio, then verify it back.

## Flows
1. **Register Ownership** — map a 16-bit watermark to an owner (so verify can show the owner)
2. **Embed Watermark (Upload Audio)** — upload audio + a watermark_integer; returns the WATERMARKED audio file to download
3. **Verify Watermarked Audio** — upload the embedded file; returns watermark_detected=true, the binary/integer/hex, score, and owner
4. **Verify Clean Audio** — upload audio with no watermark; returns watermark_detected=false
5. **Lookup by Integer** — resolve a watermark integer to its owner

## How embed works
`POST /api/watermark/embed/` (multipart): fields `audio_file` (File) + `watermark_integer` (0–65535) + optional `alpha` (0.0–2.0, default 1.0).
The response is the binary WAV file (download it). The embedded value is also returned in response headers:
`X-Watermark-Integer`, `X-Watermark-Binary`, `X-Watermark-Hex`.

Use Postman's **Send and Download** for the embed request so you can save the watermarked file, then upload that saved file to the Verify request.

## Auth
Collection-level **Basic Auth** (admin / 22@admiN) is sent on every request. (Endpoints are AllowAny — auth is not enforced.)

## Variables
- `base_url` — http://localhost:8000
- `watermark_integer` — value to embed / look up (default 42923)
- `audio_file_path` — local audio to watermark
- `watermarked_file_path` — the file you saved from the embed response
- `no_watermark_file_path` — clean audio for the negative case

body.raw:
{
  "watermark_binary": "{{watermark_binary}}",
  "copyright_name": "TVD COPYRIGHT",
  "company_name": "TVD Technologies",
  "owner_name": "TVD Media Pvt Ltd",
  "contact_email": "legal@tvd.com",
  "notes": "Primary catalog registration"
}

request.description: Register the 16-bit watermark binary (= integer 42923) against an owner. Expected 201 CREATED. Run once so the Verify/Lookup requests can resolve the owner. Returns 409 if already registered.

formdata.description: Audio to watermark. In the UI set this row's type to 'File' and click 'Select Files'.

request.description:
Upload audio + watermark_integer; embeds the AudioSeal watermark and RETURNS the watermarked WAV file (16kHz mono, 16-bit PCM).

>> Use 'Send and Download' (dropdown next to Send) to save the file, then upload that saved file in request 3.

The embedded value is also in the response headers: X-Watermark-Integer, X-Watermark-Binary, X-Watermark-Hex.

Do NOT set Content-Type manually — Postman builds the multipart boundary.

formdata.description: The watermarked file you saved from request 2 (or the sample_watermarked_42923.wav).

request.description:
Upload the watermarked audio. Expected 200 with:
- watermark_detected: true
- confidence: ~1.0 (the score)
- binary_message / integer_message / hex_message: the embedded value (e.g. 42923)
- ownership_verified: true (if registered) + owner object
- audit_id
Upload clean (un-watermarked) audio. Expected 200 with watermark_detected=false, confidence near 0.0, all message fields null, ownership_verified=false.
Resolve a 16-bit integer (0–65535) to its registered owner. Expected 200 after request 1; 404 WATERMARK_NOT_FOUND if not registered.
